description: Intelligent brainstorming facilitator that guides ideation from vague concepts to structured deliverables. Conducts iterative exploration with Socratic questioning, framework application, and web research. Generates comprehensive self-contained reports and exploration journals. Use when user says "brainstorm", "let's explore", "I have an idea", "help me think through", or needs structured ideation on features, projects, audits, or research topics. Not for simple Q&A, direct task execution, or when user already has clear specifications.
